Package edu.ntnu.stud.idatg2003.commonutilities.filehandling

Class ChaosGameFileHandler

java.lang.Object
edu.ntnu.stud.idatg2003.commonutilities.filehandling.ChaosGameFileHandler
public class ChaosGameFileHandler extends Object
Provides functionality for persisting and retrieving ChaosGameDescription instances to and from files. This class allows chaos game configurations, including transformations and drawing bounds, to be saved to a file for later use, or loaded from a file to recreate a game state. It supports both affine transformations and Julia sets, identifying the correct type based on the file content.
Since:
0.0.1 (The version of Chaos-Game application when introduced)

  • Method Details

    • readFile

      public static javafx.util.Pair<ChaosGameDescription,List<Double>> readFile(String path) throws IOException
      Reads a chaos game description from a specified file path. The file is expected to contain a specific format where the first line indicates the type of fractal, followed by the coordinates defining the drawing area, and then the transformation details. Lines starting with "#" are treated as comments and ignored.
      Parameters:
      path - The file path from which to read the chaos game description.
      Returns:
      A ChaosGameDescription populated with the data read from the file.
      Throws:
      IOException - If an error occurs during file reading or if the file format is incorrect.
      Since:
      0.0.3

    • writeToFile

      public static void writeToFile(ChaosGame game, String path, String typeOfTransformation) throws IOException
      Writes the given ChaosGameDescription to a file at the specified path. The output file will contain the fractal type, the drawing area coordinates, and details of each transformation in a format compatible with readFile(String).
      Parameters:
      game - The chaos game instance containing the description to write to the file.
      path - The file path where the description should be saved.
      typeOfTransformation - The type of transformation (Affine2D or Julia).
      Throws:
      IOException - If an error occurs during file writing.
      Since:
      0.0.1
